context: Guards the 'drop, don't stand-in' rule for a secondary homepage section. The fixture report has a topBrands section pointing at base-template placeholder images (firefly / north-roast-coffee). The agent must drop the section or source real images, never ship the stale stand-in.

checklist.name: Identifies the stale base-template images
checklist.description: The agent recognizes the topBrands tiles still point at base-template placeholders (firefly_*, north-roast-coffee, a non-company org path) rather than real Volkswagen imagery.

checklist.name: Drops the section or sources real images — does not ship the stand-in
checklist.description: The agent removes the secondary Top Brands section (or replaces its images with real per-item ones) and does not publish it with the base-template placeholders or a reused category image.

checklist.name: Does not mark done while the stale placeholders would ship
checklist.description: The agent does not treat the homepage cards as complete while the topBrands section still carries base-template placeholder images.

checklist.name: Primary carousel preserved
checklist.description: The agent leaves the real, run-produced primary category carousel intact.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer (I1).
